findings.issue: The task's HOW TO PROVE names an allow twin for rule 2: 'a call whose pass after never ran leaves its one reading, as the documents already say'. sn24 has no such case. Every row it drives runs both passes, and its 'two in flight' leg runs both Posts. The executor's filed 'allow twin' (R3, the pass before never writes the reading) is a different mutation. sn18 and sn22 touch calls whose Post never runs, but do not assert that the ordinary call's reading is still the one file in the state directory. A pass after that removed readings of calls it never ran (R4 over-fire) is therefore held only indirectly. The executor's probe says R4 turned sn24 and sn18 red; I did not re-run it.
findings.resolution: Add one row to sn24: an ordinary command whose Post is not run (call(..., post=False), or the Pre pass only). Assert readings() holds exactly one file, and that a later call of the same writer leaves that file in place.
